headline: China's national AI cybersecurity test reports 32 strong-performing teams across eight scenarios
summary: China's official result notice says a national AI-enabled cybersecurity application test drew 251 teams from 151 organizations across eight scenarios, with 32 teams described as achieving good results. The CAC release names teams by scenario but gives no scores or thresholds. CNCERT's earlier notice describes two stages and says the top six teams per scenario advanced to in-person testing; the organizer also restricted public sharing of detailed test materials and results without permission.
